name: Quadrant Televentures Limited
about: Quadrant Televentures Limited provides telecommunication services in North India. The company offers voice telephony, internet, and broadband data services. It also provides value-added services, including Centrex, leased lines, VPNs, voicemail, etc. In addition, the company offers connectivity solutions, such as internet leased line and multiprotocol label switching (MPLS); fiber optic cable; voice services comprising primary rate interface (PRI) and session initiation protocol trunk solution. Further, it provides OTT subscription and IPTV packs. The company was formerly known as HFCL Infotel Limited and changed its name to Quadrant Televentures Limited in September 2010. Quadrant Televentures Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Mohali, India.
